name: Imprisoned Mythos
description: Epic chronicles, romantic legends, and the countless ages that gave them meaning. From these emerged all spiritual beliefs. It is no longer a prisoner, it shall die in the funeral of Gnosis, leaving behind an iron-cast tombstone.

skills.name: Echoes of Tragedy
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to one designated target and delays their action.

skills.name: Eternal Misfortune Inflamed
skills.description: Locks onto 2 targets to enter "Deliverance of Relief" state. "Anti-Creator" will use "The Spirit's Prison Shall Burn" on their next action.

skills.name: Eternal Recurrence
skills.description: When this unit enters the "Grave Wound" state, restores all HP and dispels the "Grave Wound" state on next action.

skills.name: Immortal
skills.description: Immune to the effects of action bar changes, except from "Anti-Creator." "Mythos" cannot be eliminated. When receiving a killing blow, enters the "Grave Wound" state and advances all targets' actions.
